text:
Alex: Heads-up — TigerHealth wants a 14-day POC to prove convo routing + automated case summaries. They need clear acceptance gates, security controls (KMS, EU data), and a burn estimate.
Priya: Do we have expected concurrency? that'll decide Dedicated sizing.
Alex: Rough: steady 40 reqs/min, spikes to 140. Avg convo ~520 tokens. Targets: routing p95 <=400ms, summary p95 <=800ms.
Ben: Security note — customer insists on customer-managed KMS, EU-only data, and SIEM integration. Can we disable persistent caching for POC?
OpsBot: Dedicated in eu-west-1 available. Reserve request pending.
Alex: Draft acceptance gates:
- Routing accuracy >=91% on 400 labeled chats
- Summaries: human agreement >=85% on 150 samples OR ROUGE-L >=0.60
- Latency: routing p95 <=400ms; summarization p95 <=800ms under normal load
- Cost: <= $0.017 per 1k input tokens (POC estimate)
- Reliability: fallback to quantized distill if errors >1% or latency >900ms for 5m; responses include "served_by" metadata
Priya: Sample eval prompt to share with Eng-ML: 
"You are a concise case summarizer. Output JSON with keys: summary, action_items, severity."
Ben: Confirmed: transient sessions, KV cache disabled, blobs encrypted with customer KMS. Redaction pipeline available on ingest.
Alex: Cost quickcalc: 6.24M tokens/day -> ~$106/day at $0.017 per 1k -> ~ $1.5k for 14d plus infra. Recommend a 3-hr load test on day 2 and a canary switch to quantized model if burn too high.
Priya: I'll own eval harness. Alex, can you draft the runbook and I'll wire metrics?
Alex: Will do. OpsBot: Dedicated reservation confirmed for eu-west-1 (2xA10G) 2026-04-20 08:00 -> 2026-05-04 08:00.
Ben: I'll reply to customer security questionnaire and include IR contact.
Alex: Next steps: finalize gates with TigerHealth by EOD tomorrow, finalize SOW, then spin up Dedicated. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
